raw_resume.summary: Software Engineer with 3+ years of professional experience building scalable backend systems in Java and Spring Boot. Seeking the Software Engineer II role at Google Cloud, with a track record of optimising system performance, designing microservices architectures, and mentoring engineering teams.

bullets: Reduced p95 latency of the settlement API from 800 ms to 350 ms by adding Redis caching.
Split the monolithic payouts module into 4 Spring Boot microservices communicating over REST.
Mentored 2 junior engineers and conducted code reviews in 2-week Agile sprints.
Implemented JPA/Hibernate repositories and MySQL schema changes for the merchant onboarding service.
Automated nightly reconciliation reports, saving the operations team 6 hours per week.

profile_improvement_tips: Gain hands-on experience with Python or JavaScript to match the JD's core language requirements; consider contributing to open-source projects or building a side project in one of these languages.

Deepen your System Design and Distributed Systems knowledge through structured learning (e.g. Grokking System Design, LeetCode system design problems) and apply these concepts in your current role to strengthen your candidacy for a senior engineering position.

Explore Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services (Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, Pub/Sub, Datastore) in a personal or work project to demonstrate cloud-native development experience, which is critical for a Google Cloud role.
raw_resume.growth_note: You have strong Java and microservices experience, but the JD emphasises multiple programming languages (Python, C++, JavaScript) and GCP expertise, neither of which are evident in your profile. Your 3+ years of professional experience meets the minimum, but the skill gap in languages and cloud platform knowledge limits your competitiveness for this specific role.
